name: Scare & Banana's
summary:
Scare & Banana's is a thrilling and chaotic Gorilla Tag fan game where you're not just monkeying around — you're fighting to survive.

Trapped deep inside a mysterious lab, a group of monkes desperately tries to escape. But something has gone horribly wrong… Some monkes have mutated into terrifying monsters, twisted by unknown experiments, and they’re hunting down anything that moves — including you.

Use your parkour skills, stay sharp, and stick with your group if you want a chance to survive the madness.
